caption:
Nobody buys a warranty they can't read.

"Linear performance warranty" is a legal title, not an answer.
Homeowners ask simpler things: will my panels still work in 20 years? If one fails, who swaps it? If the roof leaks after the install, do you come back?
Write those questions on your warranty page, word for word, and answer each one in a sentence.
Then add one table: part, years covered, who they call.
Make "who they call" you, for every part, even when the manufacturer pays.
And say what is not covered in one plain line instead of an asterisk.
